KERA.tissue: Healthy adult cornea (19,472 cells, 10x scRNA-seq, in vivo dissociation)
KERA.evidence: Body text: 'KERA is corneal stromal–specific' (Fig.1c) and 'clusters S0, S1 and S2 were stromal keratocytes' (Fig.5b); abstract: NNMT/KERA sentence
KERA.semantics: Gene-by-gene expression localization (this card verified via v2.2 library chunk body extraction, 2026-09-24)

ALDH3A1.evidence: Body text: 'stromal keratocyte markers LUM, KERA, or ALDH3A1... S0/S1/S2 were stromal keratocytes'

ALDH3A1.note: Corneal epithelium (HCE-2) also has ALDH3A1 functional studies —— epithelial co-expression limitation, single gene cannot distinguish stroma from epithelium
Strain-upregulated human corneal cells ALDH3A1 (FASEB J 2024; cell experiment context)

NNMT.evidence: Abstract+body text: 'NNMT was exclusively expressed by stromal keratocytes' (new finding stromal keratocyte marker in this study)

LUM.note: Keratocyte association established (Fig.5b) but shared with fibroblasts of other tissues, not independent subtype criterion —— astra downgrade with annotation
Human cornea Stro cluster expression profile context

DCN.note: Corneal stroma SLRP background; 'Fibro=DCN+' does not constitute keratocyte-specific evidence —— astra downgrade canonical-only

PTGDS.note: Cultured bovine corneal keratocytes produce PGD synthase —— species+culture criteria, not extrapolated to adult in vivo identification marker

_aux_evidence_not_in_default_markers.MIME1_identity_note: Task book candidate 'MIME1'(mimecan) human official symbol identity mapping unverified (OGN is alternative symbol pending verification); must not default change into library without verification —— astra deprecates current gene key

_disambiguation.hierarchy: Keratocytes = corneal stroma resident cell subtype; corresponds to Fibroblasts superclass in Q6 existing classification system (D002 baseline fine_types already includes Corneal Stromal Keratocytes), not a mutually exclusive parallel class.
_disambiguation.vs_corneal_endothelium: Corneal endothelial identity should show SLC4A11/CA3/CDH2 combined expression; KERA/ALDH3A1/NNMT combination positive suggests stromal keratocyte identity rather than endothelial —— combined evidence explanation, does not constitute single gene positive/negative mechanical exclusion rule.
_disambiguation.vs_fibroblast_shared: DCN/LUM/PTGDS shared with membrane library Fibroblast class non-discriminative; stromal resident identity relies on KERA/NNMT/ALDH3A1 combination.
_disambiguation.evidence_limits: ALDH3A1 is also expressed in corneal epithelium; stromal/epithelial signals may cross-contaminate in mixed ocular surface materials (lesson from 34741068 E3 cluster); this card does not interpret D002 endothelial donor median=0 as evidence for identity exclusion or conclusions on capture mechanisms.

SLC4A11.note: One of the most widely cited specific markers for human corneal endothelium.
High SLC4A11 transcript expression is corneal endothelial-specific (Sci Rep 2026; at the transcript level, claims of absolute specificity remain limited).

CDH2.evidence: Body text: 'stromal keratocytes... endothelial cells (Endo, CA3+, CDH2+, and SLC4A11)' —— endothelial population.
CDH2.semantics: Gene-by-gene localization; non-specific auxiliary marker (junctional element identity alone does not prove cell type) —— astra adopts with annotation.

CA3.evidence: Same sentence: 'Endo, CA3+, CDH2+, and SLC4A11+'
CA3.semantics: Auxiliary candidate (non-specific); publication scope = population localization, no claim of single-gene specificity.

COL8A1.note: Descemet membrane structural collagen background; no gene-level expression localization literature in human corneal endothelial clusters (41060151 endothelial cluster sentence does not contain COL8A1) — astra downgrade to canonical-only

COL8A2.note: COL8A2 L450W early-onset Fuchs —— disease genetic association, ≠ normal adult single-cell expression specificity (downgrade with annotation).
In-library integrated study: CEC cluster unique expression CA3/COL8A2/SLC4A11 (chunk localization) —— supports direction but does not meet publication-grade default marker criteria.

TJP1.note: ZO-1 junctional structure background; no localized gene-level single-cell expression evidence in human corneal endothelium, do not fabricate PMIDs —— astra downgrades to canonical-only.

_aux_evidence_not_in_default_markers.ALCAM_abandon_note: Task brief suggested starting point ALCAM: this card found no verifiable corneal endothelial gene-level support → discarded (executing task brief clause 'do not copy verbatim').

_disambiguation.hierarchy: Corneal Endothelium = monolayer posterior boundary membrane of the cornea (not vascular endothelium) —— distinct hierarchical context from Membrane Library Endo (vascular endothelium: CLDN5/PECAM1/CDH5 series); reading requires first distinguishing material context.
_disambiguation.vs_keratocytes: Positive KERA/ALDH3A1/NNMT combination does not support endothelial identity; conversely, positive SLC4A11/CA3/CDH2 combination supports endothelial identity. Combination evidence explanation, not mechanical exclusion by single genes; nor should current sampled donor median 0 be interpreted as biological absence.
_disambiguation.prohibition_note: Mutual exclusion = identity mutual exclusion within the same classification hierarchy (endothelium ≠ stroma), not interpreted as two gene sets never co-expressing.
